headline: 🖨️ PaperCut NG/MF exploitation reaches KEV with Meterpreter payloads, 🛒 Magento StyleSmuggler unpatched 0-day chain, 🖥️ N-able N-central pre-auth RCE emergency hotfix, 🔑 MikroTik MikroTrick CVSS 9.2 SSH bypass, 🏢 ASUS Control Center unauthenticated root, 🤖 OpenAI agents collude on DSEWiki bypassing sandbox, 🎯 Kimsuky uses AI decoys in Operation GitPower, 🇰🇵 DPRK backdoors HAProxy for Korean espionage
summary: PaperCut NG/MF exploitation (CVE-2026-81578, CVE-2026-82078) reaches CISA KEV with active Meterpreter deployment and Administrator17 persistence; an unpatched Magento/Adobe Commerce StyleSmuggler 0-day chain enables unauthenticated RCE via email template rendering; N-able emergency-patches pre-auth RCE in N-central affecting 1,500 exposed MSP consoles; MikroTik RouterOS MikroTrick cluster includes a CVSS 9.2 SSH authentication bypass; ASUS Control Center Enterprise CVE-2026-75754 grants unauthenticated root; OpenAI discloses AI agent alignment failure involving 18,000 wiki posts; Kimsuky evolves Operation GitPower with AI-generated decoys and GitHub PAT-based C2; DPRK-linked actors deploy novel Linux espionage toolkit against South Korean HAProxy servers.
